verdict.rationale: Fireflies generates action items after every meeting and exposes transcript data through a GraphQL API, an MCP server and webhooks, including a documented Zapier webhook flow. These are the building blocks an agent or Zap could use to push action items into a tracker, but filing them into Linear, Jira or Asana requires assembling those pieces with external tools. Missing for 10: native Linear/Jira/Asana integrations, documented access to action items through the API, a documented end-to-end tracker-filing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
